parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$\text{Resolve}\,\text{perpendicular}\,R=6g\,\cos\,t+12\,\sin\,t$ — M1*.

$\text{Correct}\,\text{perpendicular}\,\text{equation}\,R=6g\,\cos\,t+12\,\sin\,t$ — A1.

$\text{resolve}\,\text{parallel}\,F=6g\,\sin\,t-12\,\cos\,t$ — A1.

Apply $F=\mu R$ — DM1.

$\text{rearrange}\,\text{to}\,\mu=(5\tan\,t-1)/(5+\tan\,t)\,AG$ — A1.

Total: 5
